meta.description: The one gate kind the web MVP has: a spend gate, opened directly by code from estimate_cost when needsGate is true (no separate request_gate tool call). estimate_cost's optional items list (the roles being researched) is included and shown in the gate's text under the action, so the candidate sees which six roles, not just a count. A non-yes reply leaves the gate pending; the typed yes approves it. No internal gate id appears in candidate-facing text.

parts.text: can you evaluate the 6 roles I saved this week?

output.method: steps × per-step cost measured so far this chat (median for lowUsd, highest for highUsd); web searches at the plugin's listed price
